rationale: Single versioned Visa rulebook PDF — authoritative reference artifact, re-fetched periodically rather than a signal stream.
Mastercard public rulebook PDF; Europe-Region chapter is durable reference evidence, not a producing hub.
Mastercard Economics Institute publishes recurring CZ-relevant spend forecasts, but URL failed — re-check liveness before approving.

Amex CZ country site documents a shifting three-party scheme footprint; standalone domain, low volume.
Diners Club CZ site is the only reference on residual acceptance-only status, but URL verification failed — recheck.
UnionPay news centre is a live feed publishing hard CZ acceptance counts unavailable elsewhere.
One ČSOB merchant-manual PDF; ground truth on CZ terminal brand acceptance but a static artifact.
Czech business-news hub continually relays scheme statistics with figures intact; moderate credibility, high recall value.
Discover Global Network homepage is a partner/acceptance index to mine once for the CZ brand carrier.
Single GoPay blog post chronicling CZ card milestones — dating evidence, not a monitored stream.
Versioned ČNB CERTIS participant register; official, public, change-trackable membership of the domestic rail.
Definitive ČNB instant-payments participant list — the CZ instant adoption baseline, versioned and public.
Canonical ČNB bank-code/BIC registry; the join key for all CZ institution-level payment datasets.
ČNB payment-statistics reporting-population list defines who reports and publishes; recurring updates.
ČNB Lab payments research stream publishes recurring analysis on instant payments and cash usage.
Single ČBA QR standard PDF — normative basis of QR Platba/SPAYD, versioned artifact rather than a feed.
ČBA association portal publishes sector statistics, standards and member lists; parent of the standard PDFs.
Official QR Platba/SPAYD standard site; CZ-specific payment structure absent from international data.
One KB technical spec PDF showing bank-level SPAYD implementation; supporting evidence only.
Bank iD operator site publishes recurring national e-ID user and verification volumes — core CZ rail uptake metric.
State NIA identity portal documents accepted means, connected providers and usage; public and clearly allowed.
Government agency news archive with recurring eIdentita login statistics corroborating Bank iD figures.
Dominant CZ processor/acquirer corporate site; product and news pages signal terminal estate and portfolio moves.
Worldline CZ site covers the second major acquirer/processor; local pages plus group reporting give acceptance indications.
KB investor-reporting index publishes recurring digital-client and transaction metrics; bottom-up validation of adoption.
EPC register of SEPA/SCT Inst participants, downloadable and filterable to CZ PSPs; recurring updates.
